title: IT Glue configuration context
use_case: From a host in a case, find its IT Glue configuration and comment on the case with the organization, type, status, location, contact, primary IP and a link to the record.
trigger: User Initiated: a Response Action on Host, which an analyst runs from the host in a case. Leave When does this playbook run? at Always.
connections: Unofficial_ITGlue 1.0.0, the IT Glue connector from this library: an API key without password access
Taegis.Case 1.0.5, the case connector Sophos manages, to comment on the case
requires: IT Glue, an API key without password access, and Sophos Fusion playbooks under Security Operations > Automations
mdr_note: Sophos MDR doesn't run or watch this playbook, and it doesn't change what Sophos MDR does. It only reads IT Glue and adds a comment to the case, which Sophos MDR analysts can see on a case they share with you.
rollback: Delete the comment on the case if you don't want it. Nothing in IT Glue changes.
author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Not run against IT Glue: there was no account to test with. On 2026-10-21 a renamed copy passed playbookValidateDSLV2 with no errors or warnings in a Sophos Fusion tenant, imported with its connector, exported again unchanged apart from the tenant's own fields, and both were deleted.
